verdict.rationale: GitHub's docs say users can "Fork a repository to create a new repository on GitHub," and they describe GitHub's pull request workflow as the standard way to create and review code, including reviewing PRs from mobile. Together these cover both halves of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of opening a pull request from a fork back to the upstream repository by outside contributors, maintainer controls over fork-based PRs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
